content:
Loyalty program enrollment is at all-time highs. Actual brand loyalty is declining. A look at the platforms, strategies, and one volunteerism-based program changing the math.

In this issue

  • The Old Model Is Table Stakes. Let me be blunt. If your loyalty program is still just "spend money, earn points, get a discount," you're not running a loyalty program.
  • What the Best Programs Look Like Now. The platforms driving loyalty in 2026 look fundamentally different from what we had a decade ago.
  • The Platform Landscape in 2026. If you're evaluating loyalty platforms right now, the market has matured significantly.
  • Loyalty as an Engagement Hub. The best loyalty programs in 2026 aren't just rewarding purchases.
  • KEEN Corps. The Example Worth Studying. This brings me to KEEN, the outdoor footwear brand out of Portland.
  • What This Means for Your Brand. If you don't have a loyalty program yet, just pick one and launch it this week.
  • Join Us at eTail. I'm at eTail Palm Springs this week, and the timing of this article is intentional.
